fluidcompat.config.title: Fluid Compat
fluidcompat.config.general.enableFiniteF: Master switch for the core service. Off: every machine behaves as without Fluid Compat.
fluidcompat.config.general.backendPrefer: Which system removes fluid from the world. AUTO prefers Flowing Fluids.
fluidcompat.config.fluids.finiteWater.to: Pumps drain water from the world instead of creating it.
fluidcompat.config.fluids.finiteLava.too: Pumps drain lava from the world instead of creating it.
fluidcompat.config.fluids.finiteTaggedFl: Also treat every fluid in the tag fluidcompat:managed_fluids as finite.
fluidcompat.config.pumps.drainPercent.to: How much of the world's fluid is used per unit pumped. 100 = one for one.
fluidcompat.config.pumps.minTicksBetween: Extra delay between two drains of the same pump. 0 = none.
fluidcompat.config.general.compatEnabled: Master switch for every mod compat module. Off: the supported machines keep their original behaviour.
fluidcompat.config.energized_power.enabl: Fluid Pump, Advanced Fluid Pump and Drain: the tank gets only what the world gave up when they pick up thin water.
fluidcompat.config.energized_power.place: Off (default): the pump still needs and uses up a cobblestone, but no block is placed, so it drains real water. On: the original behaviour, a cobblestone block replaces the drained cell.
Teach Flowing Fluids that pipe blocks are special. Needs a restart.
Register the pipe blocks with Flowing Fluids as blocks that never push fluid out of their cell. Needs a world restart.
How Flowing Fluids treats waterlogged blocks. IGNORE (default) is the safe one. This is a global Flowing Fluids setting, applied in memory only when a world starts.
DANGEROUS: lets the waterlog flow mode be anything but IGNORE. Water has been duplicated that way.
fluidcompat.config.fluidloggable_pipes.e: Let the pipe blocks listed in blockClasses hold fluid through Fluidloggable. Needs a restart.
fluidcompat.config.fluidloggable_pipes.a: DANGEROUS, keep off unless testing. Fluidloggable keeps its own copy of the fluid in each chunk section, next to the block state. The same design duplicated water with Flowing Fluids. The pipe hook only works when this is on.
fluidcompat.config.logging.verbose.toolt: Log one throttled line per machine for every intake.
fluidcompat.config.logging.debugMode.too: Log every intake and extra diagnostics. Can write a lot.
fluidcompat.config.logging.verboseThrott: Minimum time between two verbose lines of the same machine.
